categories.name: Academics
categories.channel: Faculty advisor and your school office

facts.text: Students can contact their faculty advisor for academic-related assistance.

The university has 11 schools: Computer Science and Engineering, Engineering, Information Science, Management, Commerce, Law, Design, Media Studies, Liberal Arts and Sciences, Allied and Healthcare Professions, and Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Computing. They offer 50+ UG, PG, PhD and diploma programs.
Undergraduate programs follow the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS), in place since the 2021-22 academic year. Every student also completes twenty life-skills activities during their stay.
The Academic Calendar for 2026-27, including school-wise calendars, is published as PDFs on the university's Academic Calendar page.

facts.text: Students must follow the minimum attendance requirement prescribed by university regulations; the rules are in the Student Handbook. The exact percentage was not captured in this knowledge base.
Hostel residents cannot stay in the hostel during class hours (8:30 AM to 4:30 PM) unless medically excused.

categories.name: Examinations

facts.text: The Examination Cell handles end-term, mid-term, quiz, summer-term and improvement exams, uses a digital valuation system, and applies relative grading benchmarked against the class average.
Examination timetables are published as PDFs, grouped by school and exam (for example Make-Up Examinations, October 2026), on the university's Time Table page.

Students view and download semester-wise results through the university's online examination portal, reached from the Examinations page. Grade review is requested through the same portal and applies only to theory courses.
Companies that need student records verified use the document-verification form on the Examinations page, which carries a fee of Rs 1000 per verification.

categories.name: Placements

facts.text: Placements are handled by the Career Services Division. Students can contact the Career Services / Placement Department for training and placement information.
The Career Services team is headed by the Director, Placement & Training, reachable at director_placements@presidencyuniversity.in.
Students go on industry internships lasting two months as part of Professional Practice.
Placement statistics, notifications and industry partners are listed in the Placements section of the website. A highest-package figure was not captured here.

categories.name: Library

facts.text: The library is open Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM, and stays open until 8:00 PM during end-term exams. (as listed in the 2023 Student Handbook; confirm current timings with the library).
Book issue and return (circulation) runs from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM.
The library is closed on Sundays and university holidays.
Library access is limited to the university's students, faculty and staff, and students must bring their ID card for library transactions.
The library is spread across three locations: the main library in the Management Block, the Library Annexe (management and commerce), and the second floor of E block (School of Law).
The collection has over 40,500 books, 343 national and international journals, 45 magazines and 23 online databases, plus 35 newspapers.

Library services include the KOHA catalogue (WEB OPAC, usable on and off campus), a self check-out kiosk and book drop box, remote access to e-resources, plagiarism checks (Turnitin), free reprography, 25 internet computers and the Libraries in Hand mobile app.

categories.name: Hostel

facts.text: There are three hostels for boys and girls, with twin-shared and triple-shared rooms.
Hostel accommodation is offered on a first-come, first-served basis; hostels and rooms are allotted randomly and cannot be changed once allotted.
Hostellers must be inside the hostel premises before 7:00 PM.
Hostel-related complaints should be submitted to the Hostel Administration.

Rooms include a cot, study table and chair, cupboard and free Wi-Fi. Hostels also have a dining area with meals four times a day, laundry rooms, common rooms with TV, indoor and outdoor games, and hot and cold purified drinking water.
Hostels have round-the-clock security with CCTV, resident wardens, a medical room with a nurse overnight and an ambulance for emergencies.

facts.text: Event announcements are on the Events page, notices on the Academics Notices page, and placement notifications in the Placements section.
